NORTHERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
The Notification made under Chapter 255 of the Urban Council Ordinance, No. 67 of 1939 read with Section 2 of the
Provincial Council (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989

I, The Chief Minister and the Minister of Finance and Planning, Law and Order, Land, Electricity, Housing and Construction,Industries and Enterprise Promotion, Tourism, Local Government and Provincial Administration, after a keen study of decisionswhich have been submitted by the One Man Commission of inquiry comprising of Mr. Kandiah Ariyanayakam, retired DistrictJudge, who was appointed under Sub Section (1B)(a) of the Urban Council Ordinance No. 67 of 1939 read with Section 2 ofthe Provinicial Council (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989 have come to certain independent conclusions.

Accordingly I am satisfied by the conclusion set out in the inquiry report that activities of Valvettithurai UrbanCouncil had been wantonly disturbed resulting in wilful neglect in the performance of their duties.

Hence, being so satisfied, it is informed that the Velvettithurai Urban Council is dissolved with effect from 01.01.2015according to Section 184(4A)(a) (Chapter 255) of the Urban Council (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989.
C. V. WIGNESWARAN, Chief Minister and the Minister of Finance and Planning,Law and Order, Land, Electricity, Housing and Construction,Industries and Enterprise Promotion, Tourism, Local Government
and Provincial Administration,
Northern Provincial Council.
